_source.how: `systemctl status U --no-pager -l` before and after `systemctl stop U`, and `systemctl restart|reload|kill auditd` as root, in containers that boot systemd as PID 1 (the helper images w2sd-* of wave w2/systemd: debian:12 --cgroupns=private, rockylinux:9 --cgroupns=private, centos:7 --cgroupns=host; recorder task-3.10-25-rec1.py (needs scripts/lib.py of wave w2/systemd) in the ledger folder of the task); audit installed with dnf / yum in the running container for the auditd cases. Times, pids and sizes are normalised as in the other systemd fixtures.
_source.not_recorded: the auditd service of the containers fails to start (a container artefact); only the refusal texts count
_source.digests_note: image ids of the local copies (docker image inspect, 2026-10-28) of the base images and of the helper images the recording ran in; the helpers were built after the bases (2026-10-21)
